en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn and Abu Ayoub, form Muhammad Bin Muslim,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding a man who said to his wife, ‘O adulteress, I have committed adultery with you’. Heasws said: ‘Upon him is one Penalty (Hadd) due to slandering her, and as for his words, ‘I have commited adultery with you’, so there is no Penalty (Hadd) with regards to it, except if he were to testify against her with four testimonies with the adultery in the presence of the Imamasws’.
